purpose: Test whether explicit business/actual/expected evidence can improve the current issue-flow ranking without changing candidates or embeddings
candidate_source: Unchanged production issue hybrid, top 100, query:/query:
method: Min-max normalize the current hybrid score inside its returned pool, then add the existing duplicate-pipeline positive structured bonus capped at 0.15
contradiction_policy: Do not subtract conflicts in ranking; preserve useful cross-channel/actor related issues. Conflict remains suitable for labeling, not this recall-oriented ordering probe.
weights: Frozen values from configs/dup_v2_frozen.json; no fit or sweep on the 204 labels
evaluation: All 40 reviewed queries; grade 1 and 2 are relevant; unjudged corpus issues remain unknown
go_no_go: Known macro R@10 improves, R@100 unchanged, no connected component loses R@10, judged-pool nDCG does not decrease, and known grade-0 exposure@10 does not increase
deployment: A pass is only a development signal because these AI labels are not an independent holdout
